neighbours.label: ' week' or ' weekend' after 'this', as a near-future or current time (until this weekend, this week's)
fire: The team will stay in Denver until this weekend for practice.
He earned a spot in this week's golf tournament.
She is teaching in Peru through this weekend with her class.
Fans can watch this week's match on the local channel.
The fair runs in town until this weekend at the park.
They were invited to this week's meeting in Geneva.
We will be at the lake this weekend with the kids.
The mayor spoke at this week's council session.
quiet: The team will stay in Denver during spring for practice.
He earned a spot in the national golf tournament.
She is teaching in Peru with her class from Ohio.
Fans can watch the final match on the local channel.
The fair runs in town near the old park.
They were invited to a formal meeting in Geneva.
We will be at the lake with the kids and the dog.
The mayor spoke at a noisy council session.

notes: Card: ' now' x5, ' year' x4, '7' x3, ' weekend' x2, ' week' x2, ' today' x2. Probes: 'this weekend' 0.727, 'this week's' 0.535; 'in a few days' 0.011, '2017' 0.028. Near misses keep the sentences with another time or none.
